label: Legal/normative
definition: ability to create or constrain binding rules

label: Executive/administrative
definition: ability to implement policy and allocate administrative capacity

label: Financial
definition: credit, debt, insurance, capital-market access, liquidity

label: Market
definition: market share, buyer/seller power, switching barriers

label: Information
definition: production, editing, distribution, ranking, audience exposure

label: Judicial/review
definition: ability to invalidate, suspend, or remedy acts

label: Network/influence
definition: lobbying, professional access, personnel mobility, agenda access

label: Coercive/security
definition: lawful coercive capacity, policing, sanctions, security
